description: This file defines a utility class MathUtil for performing mathematical operations such as deep copying 2D arrays, summing elements, setting all elements in a 2D array to a specific value, and squaring a number. It is part of the com.rusefi.autotune package related to autotuning functionality.

classes.name: MathUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for mathematical operations related to 2D arrays and numeric calculations.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a 2D double array.

methods.name: sumArray
methods.description: Sums all elements in a 2D double array.

methods.name: setArray2D
methods.description: Sets all elements of a 2D double array to a specified value.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Returns the square of the given value.
